# Story 01 — Knowledge Base Articles & Search (Story: CRM-102)

---

## Prerequisites

- Story CRM-24 (SDD / architecture) complete: the modular monolith pattern documented in `docs/sdd/05-architecture.md` and `docs/sdd/areas/06-knowledge-base.md` is the contract for this module.
- Authentication scaffolding in place (`backend/CRM.Api/Auth/`) — this story reuses the existing JWT bearer setup and `Roles` constants; no changes to auth.
- Frontend shell (`frontend/CRM.Web/src/components/AppShell.vue`, `frontend/CRM.Web/src/router/index.ts`) already renders authenticated routes for other management views (Quick Replies, SLA Policies) — this story follows the same navigation pattern.
- Similar precedent: **Quick Replies** module (`backend/CRM.Api/QuickReplies/*` + `frontend/CRM.Web/src/modules/quickReplies/*`). Follow its shape end-to-end (DbContext, endpoints, contracts, Pinia store, management view, i18n keys).

---

## Story Goal

Deliver a first-cut **Knowledge Base** module so agents can author, publish, browse, and search internal help articles from within the CRM.

Concrete outcomes:

1. Backend exposes CRUD for `KnowledgeBaseArticle` (title, slug, body, tags, status, timestamps, author) under `/api/knowledge-base/articles`, protected by auth.
2. Backend exposes a search endpoint (`GET /api/knowledge-base/articles/search?q=…&tag=…&status=…`) that returns a paged list ranked by title/body match and filtered by tag/status.
3. Frontend delivers a Knowledge Base management view (list + create + edit) accessible from the AppShell sidebar, plus a lightweight search box that agents can use to look up articles.
4. All new UI strings live in `frontend/CRM.Web/src/i18n/en/common.json` and `frontend/CRM.Web/src/i18n/ar/common.json`.
5. Backend and frontend tests cover the new module in the same style as the Quick Replies tests.

**Not in scope:** public/customer-portal exposure of KB articles, rich-text editor beyond a plain `<textarea>`, article versioning, article attachments, AI-suggested articles inside tickets, analytics on article views. Body is stored as plain Markdown-compatible text; rendering is deferred.

## Backend Tasks

### 1 — Create the `KnowledgeBase` module folder

Create the folder `backend/CRM.Api/KnowledgeBase/` mirroring the shape of `backend/CRM.Api/QuickReplies/`.

### 2 — Entity

**Create file:** `backend/CRM.Api/KnowledgeBase/KnowledgeBaseArticle.cs`

```csharp
namespace CRM.Api.KnowledgeBase;

public class KnowledgeBaseArticle
{
    public Guid Id { get; set; }
    public string Title { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public string Slug { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public string Body { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public string[] Tags { get; set; } = Array.Empty<string>();
    public KnowledgeBaseArticleStatus Status { get; set; } = KnowledgeBaseArticleStatus.Draft;
    public Guid AuthorId { get; set; }
    public DateTimeOffset CreatedAt { get; set; }
    public DateTimeOffset UpdatedAt { get; set; }
    public DateTimeOffset? PublishedAt { get; set; }
}

public enum KnowledgeBaseArticleStatus
{
    Draft = 0,
    Published = 1,
    Archived = 2,
}
```

Constraints: `Title` non-empty ≤ 200 chars; `Slug` non-empty, `[a-z0-9-]+`, ≤ 200 chars, unique; `Body` ≤ 20 000 chars; `Tags` at most 20 items, each ≤ 40 chars.

### 3 — DbContext

**Create file:** `backend/CRM.Api/KnowledgeBase/KnowledgeBaseDbContext.cs`

Model matches `QuickReplyDbContext`:

- Table name `knowledge_base_articles`.
- Primary key `Id`.
- Unique index on `Slug`.
- Index on `Status`.
- Store `Tags` as PostgreSQL `text[]` (Npgsql already handles `string[]`).
- Configure `Title`, `Slug` with `HasMaxLength(200)`; `Body` with `HasMaxLength(20000)`.

### 4 — Contracts (DTOs)

**Create file:** `backend/CRM.Api/KnowledgeBase/KnowledgeBaseContracts.cs`

```csharp
namespace CRM.Api.KnowledgeBase;

public record KnowledgeBaseArticleDto(
    Guid Id,
    string Title,
    string Slug,
    string Body,
    string[] Tags,
    string Status,
    Guid AuthorId,
    DateTimeOffset CreatedAt,
    DateTimeOffset UpdatedAt,
    DateTimeOffset? PublishedAt);

public record CreateKnowledgeBaseArticleRequest(
    string Title,
    string Slug,
    string Body,
    string[]? Tags,
    string? Status);

public record UpdateKnowledgeBaseArticleRequest(
    string Title,
    string Slug,
    string Body,
    string[]? Tags,
    string? Status);

public record KnowledgeBaseSearchResultDto(
    IReadOnlyList<KnowledgeBaseArticleDto> Items,
    int Total);
```

### 5 — Endpoints

**Create file:** `backend/CRM.Api/KnowledgeBase/KnowledgeBaseEndpoints.cs`

Expose an extension `IEndpointRouteBuilder MapKnowledgeBaseEndpoints(this IEndpointRouteBuilder app)` matching the signature style used by `QuickReplyEndpoints`. Register a group `MapGroup("/api/knowledge-base/articles").RequireAuthorization()` with the same policy used by Quick Replies (grep to confirm).

Routes:

- `GET   /` → list with query params `status`, `tag`, `page`, `pageSize` (defaults 1, 20; max 100). Returns `KnowledgeBaseSearchResultDto`.
- `GET   /search` → `q` (required, ≥ 2 chars), optional `tag`, `status`, `page`, `pageSize`. Case-insensitive `ILIKE` against `Title` and `Body`; results ordered by title-match first, then updated-at desc. Returns `KnowledgeBaseSearchResultDto`.
- `GET   /{id:guid}` → single article; 404 if missing.
- `GET   /by-slug/{slug}` → single article; 404 if missing.
- `POST  /` → create; validate slug uniqueness (409 on duplicate); set `AuthorId` from `ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier`; `CreatedAt`/`UpdatedAt = DateTimeOffset.UtcNow`; if `Status == Published`, set `PublishedAt`.
- `PUT   /{id:guid}` → update; re-check slug uniqueness excluding current row; refresh `UpdatedAt`; set/clear `PublishedAt` on status transitions.
- `DELETE /{id:guid}` → hard delete; 404 if missing; 204 on success.

Validation returns `Results.ValidationProblem(...)` with per-field errors, matching `QuickReplyEndpoints`.

## Edge Cases & Failure Modes

- **Duplicate slug on create/update** → backend returns 409 with `{ error: "slug_conflict" }`; the view maps this to `knowledgeBase.validation.slugConflict` and highlights the slug field. Enforced by unique index in `KnowledgeBaseDbContext` (task Backend 3) and a pre-check in `KnowledgeBaseEndpoints`.
- **Slug with unicode / uppercase** → server-side regex rejects with 400 `ValidationProblem`; frontend also validates before submit.
- **Empty search query (< 2 chars)** → `/search` returns 400 with `q_too_short`; the search dialog suppresses the request client-side and shows `knowledgeBase.messages.searchEmpty`.
- **Very large body (> 20 000 chars)** → backend rejects with 400; frontend enforces `maxlength` on the textarea.
- **Status transition Draft → Published** → sets `PublishedAt = UtcNow`. **Published → Draft/Archived** → keeps original `PublishedAt` (do **not** clear) so we retain first-publish history. Enforced in `KnowledgeBaseEndpoints` update handler.
- **Delete of currently-open article in another tab** → subsequent `GET /{id}` returns 404; the edit view catches this and routes back to the list with a toast.
- **Unauthenticated access** → 401 from the API; the global HTTP interceptor in `frontend/CRM.Web/src/api/http.ts` already redirects to login.
- **Concurrent edits** → last write wins in this story. Document as a follow-up (add `RowVersion` in a future story).
- **Partial migration state** → if `AddKnowledgeBase` migration fails halfway, roll back with `dotnet ef database update <previous_migration> --context KnowledgeBaseDbContext`. The table is standalone with no FK dependencies, so rollback is safe.
- **RTL layout** → the management view must render correctly in Arabic; verify by switching locale via `useLocale`.

## Migration / Rollback

- Schema change is additive (single new table `knowledge_base_articles` + indexes). Safe to deploy without downtime.
- Rollback: `dotnet ef database update <previous_migration> --context KnowledgeBaseDbContext` then revert the code drop. No other module reads from `knowledge_base_articles`.
- Half-applied state (table created but code not deployed) is harmless. Code deployed without migration (table missing) will produce 500 on first request — mitigation is to run migrations before app start (existing pattern in `Program.cs`).
